description: Defines the LoadTimingInfo structure and nested ConnectTiming class for capturing detailed network request timing metrics, including connection, SSL, proxy resolution, and service worker events.

classes.name: LoadTimingInfo
classes.description: Structure containing detailed timing information for network requests, including connection, SSL, proxy, and service worker timings.

nested_classes.name: ConnectTiming
nested_classes.description: Contains timing events related to establishing a network connection, such as DNS lookup, connect start/end, SSL start/end.
